newsitem.title: INDIA: India Mah Scooter up 10 pct before bonus.
newsitem.headline: India Mah Scooter up 10 pct before bonus.

text.p: Shares of India's Maharashtra Scooters surged 10 percent, to 254.0 rupees at the Bombay exchange on Monday ahead of the company's meeting to announce a bonus issue, traders said.
The board of Maharashtra Scooters will meet on Wednesday to finalise a bonus share issue and annual results for the year ending March 31, 1996.
The stock has jumped nearly 19 percent since April 29 when the firm announced that it would meet for a bonus issue on May 7.
The company is part of the scooter giant Bajaj Auto group.
